relations.subject: Heinrich August Jäschke
relations.place: Kyelang, Lahaul District and Spiti in North India
relations.evidence: From 1857 to 1868 he was missionary of the Herrnhuter Brüdergemeine (the Moravian Church or Moravian Brethren) in Kyelang, Lahaul District and Spiti in North India.

relations.subject: Heinrich August Jäschke
relations.evidence: In 1847, he became co-director of the Moravian boarding schools in Niesky, Germany.

relations.subject: Heinrich August Jäschke
relations.evidence: So in 1856 Jäschke joined two missionaries, Wilhelm Heyde and Eduard Pagel, in what is today northern India.
